descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S21 「手机宽度、WebKit 和 Android app 上的模式切换器」 Context switcher on phone width, WebKit and the Android app

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1e Quick Dictation is available in Hospital and absent in Nursing Home（UAT TC-21 step 1；UAT TC-04） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U5 No Clinic anywhere: absent from the context switcher and from the template picker（UAT TC-21；TFA-92599 AC 4；TFA-92599 AC 9） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

测试设计方法：设备（device） — 在手机尺寸或真机（iPhone / Pixel）上看布局和手势。

Given visual-lane targets Pixel 7 (Chromium) and iPhone 15 (WebKit); Android debug APK on the rc_api36 emulator against the local stack through adb reverse (scripts/android-lane.ts)

When Tap Nursing Home and Hospital; on Android also background (HOME) and resume the app

Then Exactly one Hospital and one Nursing Home button and no Clinic button; Quick Dictation on /rounding and absent on /snf; after resume, the same context is shown

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Today visual-lane.ts only opens fixed paths with page.goto (no taps) and reports layout, tap-size and axe findings for a human. The switch assertions are not decided until the runnerGap spec exists.

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（automated）

S21 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-21.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；辅助：DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
